hooks.name: Secret and privacy check before a write

action.prompt: Before this write lands, confirm it carries no API key, token, or other credential, and no verbatim content from the learner's personal notes. Confirm the target is not .env, a note file under sample-notes/, a file under .chroma/ or logs/, or a relevance-review CSV. If the write would place a secret or personal note text into a tracked file, stop and tell the user instead of writing.
